Home/Health insurance

Health insurance for you, your family and your parents

Pick who to cover, choose a plan and answer a few health questions. If anyone has a condition, we ask the right follow-ups and decide right here.

Plans

Three plans, all with cashless treatment

Cover amounts: . Choose one cover shared by the family, or separate cover for each person, for 1, 2 or 3 years.

Wellness

More than hospital bills

Every plan comes with a doctor on call day and night, check-ups and money off everyday care, used from the NxSure app all year.

Health questions

Your cover, decided on the spot

Instead of sending your proposal away and making you wait, we ask what we need, when we need it.

Answer for everyone

Height, weight and a short list of conditions for each person, or "none of these" in one tap.

Follow-ups for what you tick

Ticked diabetes? We ask about type, treatment and the last HbA1c, right under it.

Reports read for you

Upload a photo of a recent report. We read the values, and it can stand in for a test.

Tests at home

If a test is needed, book it here. Fasting tests only show early morning slots.

Add-ons

    Waiting periods

    • First 30 days: accidents only
    • Specific illnesses such as cataract, hernia and joint replacement: 2 years
    • Conditions you already have: 3 years on Essential, 2 on Plus and 1 on Premier

    Premiums qualify for tax benefits under Section 80D of the old tax regime. Individual health insurance carries no GST.

    Claims

    Cashless at network hospitals

    Planned or emergency

    Show your NxSure e-card at a network hospital. The hospital asks us for approval.

    Approval within an hour

    IRDAI's rules require a decision on a cashless request within one hour, and final approval within three hours of the discharge request.

    Or claim it back

    Treated elsewhere? Upload the discharge summary and bills, and we pay into your bank account.

    You'll need the ages of the people you want to cover.

    Motor claims

    What happens after you report

    Repairs at a network garage are cashless. Everything you told us when you bought is already on file.

    These are the longest times allowed under IRDAI's 2024 rules for motor claims.

    For a motor claim, keep handy

    • Photos of the damage and the number plate
    • Driving licence of the person driving
    • An FIR for theft, or where someone was injured
    • The repair estimate, if you aren't using a network garage

    For a health claim, keep handy

    • Discharge summary
    • Hospital bills and payment receipts
    • Test reports and prescriptions
    • Your bank details, for reimbursement
    No claim held up for paperwork

    We collect the documents we need when you buy. Under IRDAI's rules, a claim can't be rejected for want of documents.

    Home/Renew

    Renew in a few taps, from any insurer

    Enter your vehicle number, or upload last year's policy. Your no-claim bonus comes with you, even if you're switching to us.

    Or and we'll fill it all in.

    Your no-claim bonus

    A discount on the own-damage premium for every claim-free year.

    On time

    Renew any time up to 90 days before your policy ends. Your new cover starts the day after the old one ends.

    Already lapsed

    Third-party cover can start straight away. Own-damage cover starts after a quick photo inspection on your phone.

    Health policies

    Renew from your account. There are no fresh health questions unless you add someone new.

    Home/Why NxSure

    How we designed NxSure

    We compared three ways of buying motor insurance: Lemonade Car, Ping An, and the typical Indian journey. Lemonade is strongest at making the purchase simple. Ping An is strongest at making insurance part of owning a car. India adds the rules and the channels any insurer here has to work with.

    Three models

    What each one does best

    The ambition

    A Lemonade-like conversational purchase, on Ping An-like ecosystem and data foundations, built for India's rules, underwriting and channels.

    For launch, we put completing the purchase cleanly, with the right controls, ahead of building the whole ecosystem. The ecosystem is designed in from day one and switched on step by step.

    At a glance

    Who leads where

    Our reading of the comparison, and what NxSure takes from each.

    ● Strong   ◐ Partly   ○ Weak or not described

    The journey

    Ten steps from need to relationship

    The customer confirms rather than re-enters. We do the fetching, mapping and checking in the background, and bring in a person only for judgment and exceptions.

    Who it's for

    Built for every channel in India

    Banks and NBFCs

    Offer motor and health cover in net banking, the mobile app or at the branch, pre-filled from the loan or account.

    Auto dealers

    Issue cover for a new vehicle at delivery, from the dealer's own system.

    Brokers and agents

    Share a link or start a journey with the customer, then let them finish it on their phone.

    Marketplaces

    Use our quote and buy steps inside your own comparison flow.

    How it works

    Four ways to plug in

    • Link: a tagged link for SMS, email or WhatsApp.
    • WhatsApp: the same questions, one at a time, in chat.
    • Embedded journey: the full journey inside your app or portal, in your colours.
    • API: quote, buy, change and claim from your own screens. See the docs and try the sandbox.

    What you get

    • Partner tag from the first quote through every renewal
    • Customer data pre-filled from your systems, with consent
    • Live status for every lead, quote and policy
    • Commission as allowed under IRDAI rules

    Complaints

    If something isn't right

    Step 1

    Tell us

    Write to our grievance team through Help. We acknowledge every complaint and reply within the timelines IRDAI sets.

    Step 2

    Bima Bharosa

    Not happy with our reply? Register your complaint on IRDAI's Bima Bharosa portal.

    bimabharosa.irdai.gov.in
    Step 3

    Insurance Ombudsman

    You can also approach the Insurance Ombudsman for your area, free of charge.

    cioins.co.in

    Home/Legal

    Privacy, terms and disclosures

    Your privacy

    We collect only what we need to quote, issue and service your policy: your vehicle and policy details, your KYC record, and for health cover, the health details you declare. We ask for your consent before we fetch data from the vehicle register, your previous insurer or the KYC registry, and we show you what we fetched so you can correct it.

    We follow the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and its Rules. You can ask to see, correct or erase your data, subject to what insurance law requires us to keep.

    Terms of use

    Quotes on this website depend on the details you give. The final premium and terms are those in your policy schedule. Please read the policy wording, the key features and the exclusions before you buy.

    Public disclosures

    We publish our public disclosures, including claim settlement and grievance figures, every quarter as required by IRDAI.

    Beware of spurious calls

    IRDAI is not involved in selling insurance policies, announcing bonuses or investing premiums. If you get a call making such offers, please lodge a police complaint.
